review_candidates.title: Head Of FP&A
review_candidates.description: Job Description About the Company BasharSoft is the company behind Egypt and MENA's leading hiring ecosystem, home to WUZZUF, Forasna, iCareer, and Recruitera, connecting millions of job seekers with top employers across the region. Our portfolio covers multiple products and platforms across job-tech, marketplace, and SaaS. The portfolio also includes new ventures at different stages, from early launch to scale, built on cutting-edge AI technologies. About the Role We are looking for a sharp, commercially minded Head of FP&A who operates at the intersection of financial planning and strategic decision-making. Reporting directly to the Managing Director (MD), you will cover all our products, platforms, and group companies. This is not a reporting role. You will be expected to answer the questions that shape how we allocate capital and grow: which business lines deserve more investment, why we're hitting or missing our targets, how much cash each business generates or burns, what the financial return looks like on a new product or market, and where we'll be in 12 months under different scenarios. You will be the financial co-pilot to executive leadership, owning the FP&A infrastructure, keeping a tight grip on cash flow and runway across the group, challenging business heads on unit economics, and translating complex data into clear commercial decisions. The ideal person thinks like a strategist, models like a finance professional and communicates like a business partner. Also should be using AI as a power user not just basic knowledge or light use. You should be able to show real examples of how AI improved the speed and quality of your analysis, forecasting, and reporting. Responsibilities Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) cycle, standardizing inputs and building clear alignment across all business units. Own and continuously update dynamic 3-statement financial models, 12-month rolling cash flow forecasts, and runway projections. Own cash flow management across the group: track the cash position weekly and monthly, manage working capital (receivables and payables), and flag cash risks early. Track cash burn and runway for each group company and new venture, and set clear cash targets for each. Drive capital allocation decisions, identify which business lines should receive additional investment and which should prioritize profitability and cash generation. Own monthly and quarterly financial reporting, P&L, cash flow, variance analysis — with clear narratives on why we're hitting or missing cash, revenue and EBITDA targets. Model the financial impact of strategic initiatives: reducing customer churn, improving sales productivity, launching AI products, SaaS expansion, and regional growth. Build ROI frameworks for new investments and evaluate expected returns, payback period, and cash impact before capital is committed. Partner with Product, Commercial, and Operations as a finance business partner — challenge budgets, push back on assumptions, and arbitrate trade-offs constructively. Track and analyze core business metrics: MRR/ARR, CAC, LTV, churn, take rate, GMV — depending on business line. Drive scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for key business decisions. Use AI tools professionally as part of your daily work, not occasionally: build models, automate reporting, run analysis, and write financial narratives faster and better. Set up AI workflows the finance team can reuse. Run financial reporting through ERP systems (Odoo, NetSuite) and keep data accurate and consistent across group companies. Support fundraising or board reporting processes when needed. Requirements 7–10 years of progressive FP&A or strategic finance experience. Background in tech, SaaS, marketplace, or a similarly fast-moving industry, you understand unit economics, not just accounting. (Experience in scale-ups or investment banking is a plus) Strong financial modeling skills, you build 3-statement models, ROI frameworks, and scenario analyses from scratch, not just maintain them. Proven cash flow management experience: rolling cash forecasts, working capital, and runway planning across multiple business units or entities. Professional, daily user of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or finance-specific AI), not just basic knowledge or light use. You should be able to show real examples of how AI improved the speed and quality of your analysis, forecasting, and reporting. Proficient in ERP reporting tools, like Odoo and NetSuite. Bachelor's or Masters in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field; CFA or CMA is a plus, not a must. Advanced Excel/Google Sheets; experience with BI tools (Power BI, Looker, or similar) is a plus. Comfortable working with ambiguity and shifting priorities, including building processes, templates, and reporting structures from scratch in a lean or evolving finance environment. Strong communicator, you can explain a financial story to a non-finance audience without dumbing it down. Nice to Have Experience using Python or R for deeper statistical or financial analysis. Background in growth analytics or forecasting models. Experience building or scaling a finance function from the ground up. Benefits What You'll Gain Direct impact on a portfolio of market-leading platforms across Egypt and MENA, job-tech, marketplace, and SaaS, plus new AI ventures at different stages. Direct reporting line to the MD and a seat close to key business decisions. High ownership and access to rich, multi-product financial data. Your work will directly shape how we allocate capital, grow, and compete. Collaborative environment with space for experimentation and learning. Flexible hybrid working model.

review_candidates.description: The Data Scientist will be responsible for analyzing complex operational, engineering, and performance data to generate actionable insights that support the efficiency, reliability, and continuous improvement of the solar power plant. The role involves developing analytical models, identifying trends and patterns, forecasting operational performance, and translating data into meaningful recommendations for O&M decision-making. The position will work closely with the Performance and Analytics, Engineering, Operations, and Maintenance teams to support data-driven strategies, optimize plant performance, identify operational risks, and improve overall asset reliability. Key Responsibilities Data Collection, Management, and Preparation Gather, consolidate, validate, and process large volumes of operational, engineering, maintenance, and performance data from various plant systems and data sources. Ensure data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and reliability for analysis and reporting. Work with SCADA, plant monitoring platforms, CMMS, and other operational systems to extract relevant datasets. Develop and maintain structured datasets and data pipelines to support recurring analytics and reporting requirements. Statistical Analysis and Predictive Modeling Apply statistical methods, data mining techniques, and machine learning algorithms to identify trends, correlations, anomalies, and patterns in plant operations. Develop predictive models to forecast energy generation, equipment performance, maintenance requirements, and potential operational issues. Conduct root cause and variance analysis to determine factors affecting plant performance and operational efficiency. Evaluate model accuracy and continuously improve analytical methodologies based on operational results. Solar Plant Performance and Operational Analytics Analyze historical and real-time plant data, including energy generation, Performance Ratio (PR), plant availability, equipment efficiency, and operational losses. Identify performance deviations, recurring issues, and potential opportunities for improving energy yield and plant reliability. Support the analysis of weather conditions, irradiance, temperature, and other environmental variables affecting solar power generation. Develop data-driven insights to support performance optimization and operational planning. Predictive Maintenance and Asset Reliability Analytics Analyze equipment operating data, maintenance records, failure history, and other relevant indicators to identify potential equipment risks. Develop predictive and preventive maintenance models to support maintenance planning and reduce unplanned downtime. Identify patterns associated with equipment degradation, recurring failures, and operational inefficiencies. Collaborate with Engineering and Maintenance teams to translate analytical findings into practical maintenance and reliability recommendations. Data Visualization and Reporting Develop dashboards, analytical reports, and visualizations to communicate operational trends, performance indicators, and key findings. Translate complex datasets and technical analyses into clear, actionable insights for technical and management stakeholders. Establish and maintain analytical models and reporting tools to support regular O&M performance reviews. Present findings and recommendations to relevant stakeholders to support data-driven decision-making. Process Improvement and Data-Driven Decision Support Identify opportunities to improve operational processes through advanced analytics and data-driven approaches. Support the development of analytical frameworks, performance indicators, and data science initiatives for O&M operations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address operational challenges and develop solutions supported by data. Stay updated on emerging data science methodologies, technologies, and industry practices relevant to renewable energy operations. Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. A master's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, or a related discipline is an advantage. Experience At least five (5) years of relevant experience in data science, advanced analytics, statistical modeling, or data analytics. Experience developing and implementing predictive models, machine learning solutions, and statistical analyses. Experience working with large datasets and integrating data from multiple systems and sources. Exposure to power generation, renewable energy, utilities, or other asset-intensive industries is highly preferred. Experience in solar PV plant operations, energy performance analytics, or predictive maintenance is an advantage. Working knowledge of SQL and database management for data extraction, manipulation, and integration. Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms. Knowledge of machine learning techniques, predictive analytics, time-series forecasting, and statistical modeling. Familiarity with SCADA systems, IoT data, CMMS, or industrial operational datasets is an advantage. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into practical business and operational recommendations. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
